_comment: LIKE-FOR-LIKE OWNERSHIP RESTATEMENT REGISTER, read by refresh_iqvia.py step 2c. Methodology: IQVIA_GROWTH_AND_RESTATEMENT_METHODOLOGY.md. The raw IQVIA source files are NEVER modified: matching rows are relabelled in memory while the cache is built. An entry is applied only when enabled=true AND status='approved'. Matching is exact on from_corporation + product; the optional apply_period_from/apply_period_to (inclusive, YYYY-MM) bound the relabelled months. expected_rows/expected_lcv are the audited counts at approval time: the ETL warns if a rebuild produces different numbers, which means the source changed under the mapping and the entry must be re-reviewed. Reverse an entry: set enabled=false and re-run refresh_iqvia.py.

restatements.evidence: IQVIA_SOURCE: the 3 products are reported under SANOFI 2021-01..2025-12 and under OPELLA* 2026-01..2026-08, with no overlap and the same packs (Sanofi consumer-health carve-out into Opella).

MASH* sole reporter 2021-01..2025-06; RAMEDA* continuous from 2025-07 to latest (2026-08); same packs (30MG 28, 60MG 30), molecule (duloxetine), ATC4 N06A5 and DM1s. MASH* stays active with 47 other products, so this is a single-product divestment. A single 26K RAMEDA* row in 2024-07 (before its continuous run) is an anomaly that is already under the reference owner.

MODERN PHARMA reports only this one product (2025-06..2026-05); MODERN EGYPT PHARM reports it from 2026-06 to latest; same single pack (20MG 20), no gap, no overlap. Consistent with an IQVIA re-coding of the organisation.

restatements.transfer_effective_period: n/a (data-quality correction, not an ownership transfer)
restatements.evidence: SPIMACO* is the sole reporter 2021-01..2022-09 (product discontinued after 2022-09) and so is the latest-period organisation. REPHARMA* is a single row in 2022-06 for a different pack (10MG 7), LCV 30 EGP / 7 SU, which is 0.01% of lifetime product sales. It is consolidated into the latest organisation as a documented data-quality correction.

Confirmed transfer: LIPTIS sole reporter of all packs 2021-01..2021-06; RAMEDA* continuous from 2021-07 to latest; LIPTIS leftover stock (<=3% per month) until 2022-01. NOT restated (Option B, Ahmed 2026-09-24): the 2025-10..2026-03 overlap on the new 10MG 20 pack (LIPTIS ~7% of VAXATO in those months, 14-71% of that pack; 11 rows, 5.61M LCV). It stays under LIPTIS unless independent evidence confirms the correct attribution.
restatements.decision_note: Option B approved: restate only the confirmed 2021-2022 transfer.
